title: Your data
nativeNote: Export and erasure are available from the web version of your account.
export.intro: Download everything this course has recorded about you: profile, answers, checks, companion conversations, learner model, deadlines and events. Course content and grading keys are not included.
export.done: Your data file was prepared. Check your downloads.
export.failed: Your data could not be exported right now. Nothing changed. Try again.
erase.body: This permanently removes your answers, companion conversations, learner model and personal teaching for this course. Dates, event types and usage totals are kept without content so audit and budgets stay correct. You will not be able to continue this enrollment. It is removed from the live service at once; copies in backups made earlier remain until those backups are deleted under the operator's published retention period. Download your data first if you want a copy.
erase.reason: Why are you erasing it? (10+ characters, kept with the record)
erase.stopping: Stopping your course supervisor before erasing…
erase.stillFinishing: Supervision is still finishing. Nothing was erased yet. Try again in a minute.
erase.failed: Erasure could not be completed. Nothing was erased. Check the confirmation and reason, then retry.
account.body: This erases your learning data in every course you are enrolled in, then your account: your name, sign-in name, password, passkeys and sessions, and your access to every workspace. Anything derived from your data, such as suggestions and saved companion context, goes with it. It cannot be undone, and you will be signed out on every device. Backups made earlier keep a copy until the operator's retention period ends.
account.reason: Why are you erasing your account? (10+ characters, kept with the record)
account.erased: Your account and all your course data were erased. You are signed out.
account.stopping: Stopping your course supervisors before erasing…
account.error.ACCOUNT_HAS_STAFF_ROLE: This account also has a course-team role. Ask an administrator to move that role before erasing the account.
account.failed: Account erasure could not be completed. Nothing was erased. Check the confirmation and reason, then retry.
access.title: Staff access to your record
access.body: Course owners and admins can open a read-only view of what you see here to help with your learning, and can download a copy of your data when you ask for it. They cannot act as you, and neither the view nor their copy includes your companion conversation or your own notes; only your own download does. Both include your profile: your display name, learning goal and pace, which course staff who can see your enrollment also see. Every view and download is listed here and in your data download.
access.none: No one on the course staff has viewed or downloaded your record.
access.unavailable: This list could not be loaded right now.
access.downloaded: {name} ({role}) downloaded a copy of your data
role.author: author
